text:
Maya: Heads-up — Brightway asked for a pin-extension while they finish a phased migration. They want up to 90 days. Can we design a formal migration-runway product lane (TTL + credits + gates)? cc @Sanjay @Olivia
Sanjay: Need the baseline metrics before we promise anything. Which model/version are they on and what's the observed delta?
Maya: Theyare on rwd-13b-v2 pinned. Traffic ~110 QPS, regional skew eu-west. Our canary shows a 6% semantic hit on their eval set, p95 +9ms. They said embedding recall dropped on a few queries too.
Olivia: 6% semantic loss is above our critical threshold of 3% for enterprise customers. Also want an embedding-similarity diff and top-k recall breakdown.
Liam: Suggest a "migration-runway" lane: predefined TTLs (30/60/90d), associated credit tiers (10/15/20%), weekly mandatory eval snapshots, staged canaries (5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%), and automated rollback triggers.
Devon: From CS: Brightway prefers 60 days if we add 20% credit for first 30 days and a committed reporting cadence. They also requested an explicit rollback SLA and a weekly status email.
Sanjay: Ops requirements: preflight checklist gating each canary bump, webhooks for rollback, perf SLIs, and KV-cache warmup test. If TTL>60d we should require a remediation plan with clear exit gates.
Sanjay: Draft preflight checklist:
```text
- golden-prompt evaluation (semantic + rouge/bleu where applicable)
- embedding similarity baseline (median cosine delta + recall@10)
- perf smoke: p50/p95 <= baseline + threshold
- KV-cache warm and cold-start scenarios
- fallback variant tested (fallthrough semantics validated)
- structured-output field-level invariant tests
```
Olivia: Add structured-output field presence/assertions — we saw field reorder/omission regressions last quarter. Also require a canary dataset that includes critical customer prompts.
Maya: What are the bench exit gates? i.e., when do we allow pin to expire?
Liam: Proposed bench exit gates per TTL: 30d -> semantic delta <=2% and perf within +5ms p95; 60d -> delta <=3% and perf within +8ms; 90d -> delta <=4% but requires explicit mitigation plan and weekly improvement trend.
Devon: Legal/Finance note: credits >15% need sign-off. If we offer 20% for the first month we should pre-clear finance. Also capture credit accounting in the customer contract.
Olivia: I'll run quick cost impact numbers for 30/60/90 bands and post EOD. Include both hosted consumption and dedicated pool delta.
Sanjay: Implementation: automate weekly evals and gate the canary bump via CI job that posts status to the customer channel and triggers rollback webhook on fail. I'll own the webhook integration.
Liam: I'll author the lane spec doc with canary sequencing, sample SLOs, and a customer comms template (including rollback language). Assign to me.
Maya: Assign Liam + Sanjay to ship a draft by EOW Friday. Brightway deadline is 10 business days. Devon follow up on whether 60d+20% is actually acceptable.
billing-bot: FYI — credit approvals required for >15% discounts. Please route PR to finance-approvals.
Devon: I'll confirm the customer's preferred TTL and whether they'd accept staged credits instead of flat discount.
Maya: Thanks. We'll review the draft in product sync and then loop in legal/finance. Keep posts concise — customer expects a clear yes/no on pin length within 5 business days. :hourglass:
